description: Android TV Service Menu Features - Comprehensive feature list for integration into service menu software

features.name: Color Volume / Gamut Mapping
features.description: BT.709 / DCI-P3 / BT.2020 switch + manual CMS (6-axis + white) with live Delta-E.

features.name: HDR Tone-Mapping Editor
features.description: Per-nit curve editor (PQ/HLG) with live preview; save per HDR format.

features.name: OLED/LED Panel Aging Compensation
features.description: Pixel shift, logo luminance limiter, pixel refresh scheduler, voltage offset per zone.

features.name: Local Dimming Zone Visualizer
features.description: Real-time heatmap of active zones + manual zone gain/offset.

features.name: Pixel-Level Uniformity Correction
features.description: 5×5 / 9×9 grid DDC/CI upload; stores LUT in panel EEPROM.

features.name: Motion Clarity Tuner
features.description: BFI duty cycle, MPRT target, LED scanning backlight phase.

features.name: Speaker Impedance / T&S Parameter Sweep
features.description: Measures Re, Fs, Qts, Vas; auto-generates DSP EQ preset.

features.name: Room EQ Wizard Integration
features.description: USB mic → 8-point sweep → auto-generates parametric EQ (PEQ + FIR).

features.name: Bass Management Crossover Editor
features.description: Per-channel HPF/LPF (12/24/48 dB/oct), delay, gain; saves per input.

features.name: Dialog Enhancement Profiles
features.description: Clear Voice I/II/III + custom center-channel boost + dynamic range.

features.name: Lip-Sync Auto-Calibration
features.description: HDMI ARC/eARC loopback test → auto-adjusts audio delay per input.

features.name: Speaker Protection Limiter
features.description: Real-time excursion/thermal model; sets max voltage per driver.

features.name: Wi-Fi 6E / 7 Spectrum Analyzer
features.description: Real-time FFT (2.4/5/6 GHz); channel utilization, interference map.

features.name: Bluetooth Antenna Tuning
features.description: RSSI sweep per antenna; diversity selection override.

features.name: HDMI 2.1 Compliance Test
features.description: FRL rate, DSC, VRR, ALLM, QMS, SBTM verification per port.

features.name: CEC Bus Analyzer
features.description: Live CEC frame capture/decode; device type, power status, vendor ID.

features.name: Ethernet Cable Diagnostics
features.description: TDR cable length, pair skew, PoE voltage/current.

features.name: Wi-Fi/Bluetooth Coexistence Manager
features.description: TDM slot viewer, priority override, throughput test.

features.name: eMMC/UFS Health Dashboard
features.description: Life used %, reserved blocks, bad block count, erase count, temperature history.

features.name: Thermal Zone Map
features.description: All trip points (passive/active/critical), hysteresis, fan curves per zone.

features.name: CPU/GPU DVFS Table Editor
features.description: Freq/volt tables per OPP; thermal throttle points; per-app boost overrides.

features.name: Watchdog / Reset Reason Log
features.description: Last 10 resets: POR, WDT, kernel panic, thermal, user, OTA, kernel oops.

features.name: Power Rail Monitor
features.description: PMIC rails: voltage, current, efficiency, ripple; alert thresholds.

features.name: DRAM Margin Test
features.description: Built-in MemTest86+ style; per-rank voltage/timing margin sweep.

features.name: Secure Boot Key Management
features.description: View/rotate AVB/Verity keys; OEM unlock toggle (with tamper-evident counter).

features.name: Widevine / PlayReady Keybox Provisioning
features.description: L1/L3 keybox inject, HDCP 2.3 key exchange test.

features.name: Anti-Rollback Index Manager
features.description: View/set anti-rollback version per partition; force-upgrade protection.

features.name: Factory Reset Protection (FRP) Bypass
features.description: Authorized service token (signed JWT) for authorized reset.

features.name: TEE / TrustZone Diagnostics
features.description: TEE version, TA list, shared memory usage, keystore health.

features.name: Automated Burn-In Script
features.description: CPU/GPU/DRAM/Flash/Network stress + thermal soak + log upload.

features.name: Serial Number / MAC / BT Addr Writer
features.description: One-time OTP write; locks after verify.

features.name: Panel ID / EDID Writer
features.description: Auto-read panel VESA block → writes to EEPROM + verifies.

features.name: Golden Image Hash
features.description: SHA-256 of each partition; QR code for line scan.

features.name: Aging Mode
features.description: 72h loop: video + audio + network + thermal cycle; logs to USB.

features.name: Logcat / Dmesg / Kernel Ring Buffer Dumper
features.description: Save last 1 MB to USB (no ADB).

features.name: Screenshot / Framebuffer Dump
features.description: Raw RGB + metadata (HDR metadata, color space).

features.name: EDID / HDCP / HDMI 2.1 Capability Dump
features.description: Save to USB as text/JSON.

features.name: Remote Control IR/Bluetooth Code Capture
features.description: Learn/test codes; export .ir / .bt files.

features.name: Factory Reset with Data Preservation
features.description: Wipes /data but keeps /data/media (photos/videos).

features.name: USB OTG Host Mode Test
features.description: Enumerates devices; runs USB-IF compliance subset.

features.name: Searchable Menu
features.description: Fuzzy search (type on remote/keyboard) → highlights items.

features.name: QR Code Export
features.description: Scan to upload logs/EDID/calibration to cloud.

features.name: Profile Import/Export
features.description: JSON/YAML for calibration, EQ, network, display settings.

features.name: Contextual Help
features.description: Long-press → video tooltip (stored in /vendor/service_help/).

features.name: Audit Trail
features.description: Timestamped log of every changed value (who/what/when).

features.name: Write-Protected NVRAM Regions
features.description: Prevents bricking panel/PCIe config.

features.name: Change Confirmation Dialog
features.description: "This may damage panel. Type CONFIRM to proceed."

features.name: Auto-Revert Timer
features.description: Reverts uncommitted changes after 5 min idle.

features.name: Rollback Snapshot
features.description: Auto-snapshot before any NVRAM write; one-tap revert.

features.name: Hardware Interlock
features.description: Requires service dongle (USB-C with signed cert) for write access.

levels.name: Service
levels.access: All calibration, logs, CEC, HDMI, Audio
